fullPassage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is called "hemispatial neglect." This occurs when there is damage to the brain's parietal lobe, which helps process sensory information. When it is damaged, patients cannot perceive people, sounds, and objects on one side of their body. Each of the brain's hemispheres controls the other side of the body, so patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side of the brain damage. For example, a man with damage to the left side of the brain cannot perceive what is on the right. As a result, he might only shave the left side of his face. Similarly, what if a woman suffering from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.

③ difficult—motor—same: (B) 감각 정보 처리이므로 motor 부적절 (C) same 부적절
④ easy—sensory—opposite: (A) 가장 '어려운' 질환이므로 easy 부적절

② perceive: 감각을 통해 무언가를 알아차리다·인지하다 ←정답
③ invent: 발명하다 — 인지와 무관
④ recall: 기억해내다 — 감각 인지와 다름
det.tip: 감각(시각·청각 등)을 통해 알아차리다 = perceive(인지하다)

questions.passage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is __________ (call) "hemispatial neglect." This condition occurs when the brain's parietal lobe is damaged.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: call(부르다) → called. be동사(is) 뒤에서 '~라고 불리다'라는 수동태를 만드는 과거분사
det.analysis: call을 과거분사 called로 변환. 'is called hemispatial neglect'는 '편측 공간 무시라고 불린다'라는 수동태예요. 「be동사(is) + 과거분사(called)」로 '~라고 불리다'라는 뜻을 만들어요.
det.tip: is __________ = 수동태(be + 과거분사) → call의 과거분사 called

questions.passage: What if a woman __________ (suffer) from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: suffer(겪다) → suffering. 앞의 명사 a woman을 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사(능동)
det.analysis: suffer를 현재분사 suffering으로 변환. 'a woman suffering from damage'는 '~손상을 겪고 있는 여성'이라는 뜻이에요. 명사(a woman) 뒤에서 '~하고 있는'이라고 꾸며줄 때 현재분사(-ing)를 써요. 여성이 스스로 손상을 '겪는' 주체라 능동의 -ing가 맞아요.
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 '~하고 있는'으로 꾸밈 → 현재분사(-ing) → suffering

questions.passage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is called "hemispatial neglect." This occurs when there is damage to the brain's parietal lobe, which helps process sensory information. When it is damaged, patients cannot perceive people, sounds, and objects on __________. Each of the brain's hemispheres controls the other side of the body, so patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side of the brain damage. For example, a man with damage to the left side of the brain cannot perceive what is on the right. As a result, he might only shave the left side of his face. Similarly, what if a woman suffering from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: one side of their body=몸의 한쪽 / both of their hands=두 손 모두 / the top of their head=머리 꼭대기 / the back of their neck=목 뒤
det.analysis:
① one side of their body: 두정엽 손상 시 몸의 '한쪽'에 있는 사람·소리·사물을 못 느낌 ←정답
② both of their hands: 두 손? 인지 상실은 한쪽에 국한됨
③ the top of their head: 머리 꼭대기? 문맥 무관
④ the back of their neck: 목 뒤? 문맥 무관
det.tip: 편측 무시 → 몸의 '한쪽'(one side of their body)에 있는 것을 인지 못 함

questions.passage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is called "hemispatial neglect." This occurs when there is damage to the brain's parietal lobe, which helps process sensory information. When it is damaged, patients cannot perceive people, sounds, and objects on one side of their body. Each of the brain's hemispheres controls __________, so patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side of the brain damage. For example, a man with damage to the left side of the brain cannot perceive what is on the right. As a result, he might only shave the left side of his face. Similarly, what if a woman suffering from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: the same side of the body=몸의 같은 쪽 / only the damaged half=손상된 절반만 / the front of the body=몸의 앞쪽 / the other side of the body=몸의 반대쪽
det.analysis:
① the same side of the body: 같은 쪽? 각 반구는 '반대쪽'을 통제하므로 모순
② only the damaged half: 손상된 절반만? 반구가 통제하는 것은 반대쪽 몸
③ the front of the body: 앞쪽? 좌우 대비와 무관
④ the other side of the body: 각 반구가 몸의 '반대쪽'을 통제 → 그래서 손상 반대편을 못 느낌 ←정답
det.tip: each hemisphere controls __________ → 몸의 '반대쪽'(the other side of the body)을 통제

ch: the same side of the body
the other side of the body
